entries.venue: Island Specialty Timbers tender price archive
entries.note: Page opened. Sawmill tender price per cubic metre for Huon pine craft logs, not slabs; low end. A 1.4 m x 0.45 m x 40 mm slab is about 0.025 m3, so roughly $30-110 raw timber value; sawn, dried slabs retail well above this. Guide only.

Local database, lot id 442693, same title, larger board 1.5-1.8 m. Paid locally, not resale. Recent Gowans SLAB OF HUON PINE hammers cluster $105-155 (e.g. 442694 $135, 442696 $110, 441114 $110, 436520 $140, 434907 $135); older ones $25-62 for smaller or plainer pieces. Gowans median about $55-110.

viewing_check: Smell the cut face and end grain for Huon pine's strong aroma and oily feel; measure length, width and thickness; check bark edge, staining and any splits or knots; photograph the end grain showing tight growth rings.
